offer.text: The weavers want black wool for a mourning shroud. Twelve bales, if you can dye or shear them.

accept.text: Solemn work, but honest. Thank you.

decline.text: The loom waits in silence, then.

ready.text: Twelve bales, dark as a moonless night. The weavers will begin.

complete.text: A kindness to a grieving family. Bless you.
